name: Type 055 large destroyer (Renhai class), drawn as Nanchang (101)

references.name: [A1] Anshan (DDG-103) 2023-06-05, port broadside, level
references.note: A long-lens level broadside: bow x 48, stern x 1576 (180.4 m at 8.47 px/m), waterline rows 376-382. Taken from port, so flipped to the standard starboard profile. The window starts 1.5 m above the waterline to keep the sea and the bow wave out; the photograph is soft, so whip aerials and the ensign staff are lost or thickened. The model may slide 1 m to take up the waterline band.

references.name: [A2] Anshan and helicopters 2024-10-15, port bow
references.note: For the reviewer only (not an orthographic view): the tower rising out of the forward block, the block's sloping front and chamfered corners.

references.name: [A3] Wuxi (DDG-104) 2023-08-28, from above
references.note: For the reviewer only: the forecastle cell field, the hangar roof, the pad.

must_show: one enclosed integrated mast: a faceted tower with four flat array faces, rising from the forward superstructure block
long forecastle: 130 mm gun, then the 64-cell VLS field, then the 11-barrel CIWS before the bridge
clean slab-sided hull and superstructure with one continuous knuckle; sides flared out below it, sloped in above
single funnel block amidships with the 48-cell aft VLS field behind it
hangar aft with the 24-cell HHQ-10 box on its roof, flight deck to the transom
raked stem with bulwark; transom stern
not_confirmed: exact cell-hatch layout of the two VLS fields
